name: sticky-jelly
description: A soft-body creature that lives on your desktop. Grab it, stretch it, fling it — it sticks to the edges of your screen and peels off when you pull hard enough.

scripts.start: npm run build:listen && vite build && electron desktop/main.cjs
scripts.dist: npm run build:listen && vite build && electron-builder

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Sticky Jelly asks Finder to move desktop icons out from under the creature, and puts them back when it leaves.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sticky Jelly listens when you press its microphone, so you can talk to it.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sticky Jelly turns what you say into text, on your Mac, so you can talk to it.
